43239af883decd46de6c61397daafa688fd96859: Hündle (Oberstaufen) is a small, low-key resort — 18 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Hündle (Oberstaufen)'s family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. The modest altitude of Hündle (Oberstaufen) — starting at 745 m, peaking at 1170 m — makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking snow reports before you leave is strongly recommended. The 49€ day pass places Hündle (Oberstaufen) among the mid-range resorts on budget — neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies the price for most skiers. In short: Hündle (Oberstaufen) doesn't compete with the giants of skiing, and doesn't pretend to. It's an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
